title: After max-attempts the message lands on the DLQ with messageDeadLettered and the DLQ contents match
asA: developer whose consumer needs a receipt for permanent failures without blocking the queue
iWant: a message that fails past max-attempts to land on the configured DLQ with a lifecycle event and inspectable DLQ contents
soThat: operational triage of a bad message is a matter of reading the DLQ, not of grepping application logs

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the consumer registered under maxDeliveries=3 (mapped to max_retries=2 on wrangler consumers per TAC-3002), when a handler refuses on delivery 1 and delivery 2 and delivery 3, then delivery 3's refusal routes the message into the DLQ (dead_letter_queue field), messageDeadLettered fires with { queueName, messageId, deliveries: 3, deadLetterQueue }, and no fourth delivery is attempted against the primary consumer. A boundary case at maxDeliveries=1 asserts the message crosses to DLQ on the first refusal.
acceptanceCriteria.when: the handler refuses on deliveries 1, 2 and 3
acceptanceCriteria.then: delivery 3's refusal dead-letters the message; messageDeadLettered fires with { queueName, messageId, deliveries: 3, deadLetterQueue }; no fourth primary delivery

acceptanceCriteria.description: Boundary at maxDeliveries=1. Given the consumer registered under maxDeliveries=1 (max_retries=0), when a handler refuses on delivery 1, then delivery 1's refusal routes the message into the DLQ immediately; messageDeadLettered fires with { queueName, messageId, deliveries: 1, deadLetterQueue }; no second primary delivery is attempted.
acceptanceCriteria.then: the message crosses to DLQ on the first refusal; messageDeadLettered fires with deliveries=1; no second delivery
